provenance: Prepared private-wording experiment, 2026-10-12. Six hypothetical cases keep a gratitude plan fixed; nothing executes in the simulation. Life-stage categories come from installed Stardew Valley 1.6.15.24356 Data/Characters and its verified NpcAge enum, not invented canonical ages. Exact ordinary-dialogue record/node references resolve in the ignored local corpus; source text stays outside Git. Authored controls are new writing and never model input. Source care and hashes: docs/under-glass/experiments/voice-wording-2026-10-12.md.
